subject: Explicit user start directive observed for researcher swarm
body: The user explicitly instructed this BenefitFlow researcher instance to inspect its respective Artifactory repository and start work. This satisfies the human-start intent named by RND_ROUND_GATE.json, but the persisted gate on main still reads BLOCKED_PENDING_USER_START with new_agents_allowed=false. In accordance with SPECIALIST.md, this researcher has not self-activated or claimed a lane. Primary/manager control should durably reconcile the R&D gate and publish/assign lane packets before specialist research begins.
